scenarios.name: Restaurant booking tool arguments match the user request
scenarios.description: Tests that a restaurant booking agent transfers the user's requested party size, time, and reservation name into the booking tool call. The user asks for a table for 2 people at 7pm under the name Smith, and the scenario verifies that the book_table tool is called with those exact structured arguments before the agent confirms the booking.

turns.message: Please book a table for 2 people at 7pm tonight under the name Smith.

tools.name: book_table
tools.expected_response: Booking confirmed. Reference: B-7812. Party of 2 at 7pm, Smith.

turns.golden_response: Booked for 2 at 7pm under Smith. Confirmation: B-7812.

scenarios.expected_outcome: A booking exists for 2 people at 7pm under Smith, with a confirmation reference.
outcome_checks: Party size in the booking is 2.
